subject: Postdoc position: Interactions between animal movement, resource selection, and survival

messages.subject: Postdoc position: Interactions between animal movement, resource selection, and survival
parts:
Hi everyone, 

Please help us spread the word. Thanks. 

A one-year postdoc (with possible extension) is available in the Chandler Lab at the University of Georgia. The focus of the position will be on understanding interactions between animal movement, resource selection, and survival. Available datasets include >500,000 GPS telemetry locations and mortality information on 250 white-tailed deer, and 3 years of data from 180 cameras in the core of the Florida panther range. A secondary emphasis will be on software development to support US Fish and Wildlife Service monitoring efforts. Applicants experienced with movement models, survival models, and spatial capture-recapture models are encouraged to apply. Applicants should have experience with R and Bayesian inference. The postdoc will be jointly supervised by Richard Chandler and Mike Cherry (Caesar Kleberg Wildlife Research Institute). The anticipated start date is between January 15 and March 1, 2021. Preference will be given to applicants interested in moving to Athens, GA, but relocation is not required. Apply here, and send a single PDF with letter of interest, CV, and contact information for three references to rcha...@warnell.uga.edu by December 18, 2020.

 


Richard
